Use case: precise-object-edit.
The user has SELECTED the A INK & PARCHMENT style, but corrected the material construction. The card must be ONE SINGLE CONTINUOUS FLAT SHEET OF PAPER.
Change only the paper-edge construction, preserving the chosen fine hand-drawn dark-brown ink and pale warm-gray parchment aesthetic.
REMOVE ALL curled corners, dog ears, rolled paper, turned-over triangles, folded flaps, layered inner sheets, inward peeling, visible reverse sides, and fold shadows. There are NO folds anywhere.
The border is only an ink contour DRAWN DIRECTLY ON THE SAME FLAT PAPER, not a separate raised wooden/metal frame, not a beveled rim, not a pasted sheet inside a border. Eliminate the raised double-frame/mitered rim appearance. One continuous paper face runs all the way to the genuine outer silhouette.
Replace the lost fold detail with subtle worn paper fibers, tiny scuffed outer edges, a few understated dry-ink hatching marks right along the true outer perimeter, and a very narrow softly darkened paper edge suggesting thin physical thickness. Do not create an embossed inner perimeter, recessed inner window, tear holes, heavy stains, cracked stone texture, burn damage, dark vignette, or internal drop shadows.
Keep most of the face clean, calm, blank and open for a future spell illustration; very subtle top-light to bottom-slightly-darker shading using #E5DCC9 / #DDD3BE / #D4C7AD. Do not yellow the paper. Preserve the original amount of fine artwork craft through beautiful controlled ink linework, not adding ornaments.
